llm_response.reason: Chcdrcberts.shop matches multiple scam website characteristics: 1) Selling recognized brand products at deep discounts, 2) A recently registered, obscure domain lacking company transparency, 3) No verifiable business address, real contact email, or legitimate phone number presented, 4) External scam reputation sites warn strongly against using the site (very low trust scores), 5) The site tries to convey urgency with language like '100% secure' and 'free shipping', and 6) Lacks proper legal or privacy disclosure.
